HRSD HighlightsWhere employees actually experience HRSD

Exterprise has a wealth of experience configuring and implementing ServiceNow's HR Service Delivery (HRSD) solution — including direct Now Assist for HR Service Delivery (Pro Plus Suite) certification. Employees expect a contextual experience throughout their journey with the company, and organizations are creating more technology than ever to deliver that in a hybrid work environment.

A recent IDC report suggests agile organizations retain employees at a 34% higher rate than competitors, helping them meet the demand for skills in the current war for talent.

ServiceNow's HRSD delivers a streamlined service experience through intelligent workflows: Now Assist for HRSD summarizes cases and drafts resolution notes automatically, while HR Virtual Agent lets employees self-service routine HR needs around the clock — starting from their very first day, with efficient new-hire onboarding. Workplace Service Delivery keeps day-to-day work running smoothly and boosts productivity.

Where employees actually experience HRSD

Three applications underneath the portal do most of the work — configured around your actual HR processes, not a generic template.

CASE & KNOWLEDGE MANAGEMENT

Every inquiry, one system

HR Case and Knowledge Management standardizes how employee inquiries and requests get logged, routed, and resolved — with Now Assist drafting resolution notes and surfacing knowledge articles automatically.

LIFECYCLE EVENTS & JOURNEYS

Guided, not scattered

Lifecycle Events, Journey Designer, and Journey Accelerator turn onboarding, parental leave, relocation, and promotions into a guided multi-step journey — assigning tasks to HR, managers, IT, and payroll automatically instead of coordinating it by email.

WORKPLACE SERVICE DELIVERY

Beyond HR alone

Desk moves, equipment requests, and room bookings flow through the same Employee Center portal as HR requests, so employees have one place to ask for anything — not a different system for every department.
